Metadata.title: Software, automation and AI for business
Metadata.description: Oniria builds custom software, automation and artificial intelligence for companies that want to stop running by hand and start growing.

hero.label: 0° · Software · AI · Automation
hero.title: From dream to system.
hero.lead: Oniria builds software, automation and artificial intelligence for companies that want to stop running by hand and start growing.

what.label: What we do
what.title: Less manual. More business.
what.intro: We explain technology by what it achieves, not by how it is built. We do three things.

items.title: Custom software
items.description: Web platforms and internal systems built around how your company works, not the other way round.
items.example: Your sales, accounting and marketing in one system.

items.title: Process automation
items.description: We connect the tools you already use so repetitive work gets done on its own.
items.example: Your team stops copying data between spreadsheets.

items.title: Applied artificial intelligence
items.description: Agents that read, decide and act inside your operation, under clear rules.
items.example: An agent answers your customers at 11 pm.

products.label: Products
products.title: From method to our own products.
products.intro: Besides building for other companies, we design and run our own products. They are the best sample of how we work.

how.label: How we work
how.title: From chaos to flow.
how.intro: Four steps. You see the system working before you sign.

steps.title: Analyze
steps.description: We learn how your company runs today: what is done by hand, where time is lost and what is worth changing first.

steps.title: Connect
steps.description: We link your tools and your data so information travels on its own from one place to the next.

steps.title: Implement
steps.description: We build the system, show it to you working and adjust it with your team before it goes live.

steps.title: Scale
steps.description: We measure results, correct, and add new processes once the first one runs by itself.

origin.label: Origin
origin.title: From the center of the world, for the whole world.
origin.body: The line that crosses our logo is the equator: the only one that goes all the way around the planet and joins both hemispheres. We were born on it, which is why we work for any market.

Metadata.title: Products
Metadata.description: Argos Suite and Oniric: the products Oniria designs and runs.

Products.label: Products
Products.title: Our own ideas, running as systems.
Products.intro: Each product solves one concrete operations problem. We build them with the same method we use with our clients.

argos-suite.name: Argos Suite
argos-suite.tagline: Daycare, grooming and veterinary care in one system.
argos-suite.description: Argos Suite brings together the daily operation and the finances of a pet-care business. Each area works with its own tools and all of them share the same client and pet record.
argos-suite.forWhom: Pet daycares, grooming salons and veterinary clinics, with one or several of these areas under the same roof.
argos-suite.solves: Bookings in one place, clinical records in another and payments in a spreadsheet. Argos joins them and keeps each area's accounts separate.

features.title: Daycare
features.description: Room capacity in real time, check-in and check-out with capacity control, weekly plans and transport routes.

features.title: Grooming
features.description: A schedule by time slot and a board that follows each service from appointment to pickup.

features.title: Veterinary
features.description: Consultations, clinical records, vaccines, prescriptions, hospitalization, surgery and laboratory.

features.title: Clients and pets
features.description: One record with history, vaccines and photos, shared across every area.

features.title: Finance
features.description: Payments and income separated by area, accounts payable, inventory and a consolidated dashboard.

features.title: Modules
features.description: Each business turns on only what it uses. A grooming salon never sees the clinic screens.

oniric.name: Oniric
oniric.tagline: Video and image ads for your business, with no marketing team.
oniric.description: Oniric is a platform for Latin American companies to create advertising videos and images with artificial intelligence. An assistant guides every step, in Spanish and without technical jargon.
oniric.forWhom: Business owners who have no marketing team and need an ad that is ready to publish.
oniric.solves: Producing an ad takes time, money and people a small company does not always have. Oniric cuts it down to three steps.

features.title: Three-step assistant
features.description: A guided path that takes you from your product photo to the finished ad.

features.title: Templates by industry
features.description: Starting points designed for each kind of business. The template picks the technology for you.

features.title: Commercial calendar
features.description: Campaign ideas for the dates that move sales in Ecuador.

features.title: Voice-over
features.description: The video can carry a catalog voice or your own voice, recorded in the app.

features.title: Gallery and downloads
features.description: Everything you create is saved, ready to download and share.

features.title: Prepaid credits
features.description: You buy small credit packs and pay only for what you generate.

Metadata.title: About
Metadata.description: Who we are, what we do and where Oniria comes from: the dreamcatcher, the 0° line and a method for turning ideas into systems.

About.title: Ambition to spare and a method to deliver it.
About.lead: For companies that know they can do more, Oniria is the team that turns ideas into systems that work on their own, with the rigor of a big tech company and the closeness of a small team.

facts.title: What we do
facts.description: Custom software, process automation and artificial intelligence applied to the business.

facts.title: Who it is for
facts.description: Mid-sized companies and ambitious startups, in any market. If the problem is running better, we can help.

facts.title: How we stand apart
facts.description: We show the system working before you sign. Big-tech rigor, small-team treatment.

concept.title: The dreamcatcher and the 0° line.
concept.body: Oniria comes from the oneiric: the world of dreams. A dreamcatcher keeps what is valuable and lets the noise through. That is what we do with technology: we catch your vision and turn it into something that works. Our symbol tells it in four parts.

parts.title: The net
parts.description: Below, a woven net that keeps what is valuable. It also reads as a network of connected nodes.

parts.title: The 0° line
parts.description: The equator: the only line that circles the whole planet. It says where we come from and that we look to every market.

parts.title: The trail
parts.description: Dots that grow from left to right. It is the path the idea travels.

parts.title: The idea
parts.description: The largest dot, already past the summit. The dream turned into a system.

origin.title: The origin is the signature; the world is the reach.
origin.body: Oniria was born in Quito, Ecuador, on the line that crosses our symbol. We write in neutral Spanish and work in English from day one, so the message lands the same in any country.

Metadata.title: Philosophy
Metadata.description: Seven things we believe at Oniria about technology, taste and people.

Philosophy.title: Seven things we believe.
Philosophy.lead: Not a list of values to hang on the wall. It is how we decide, every day, what to build and what not to.

items.title: AI is the ocean. We are the boat.
items.description: Technology is vast and belongs to no one. Our job is to give it a heading: take your company where it wants to go without sinking on the way.

items.title: Tools change; judgement doesn't.
items.description: Models, languages and trends change every year. What stays is knowing what is worth building.

items.title: It works first, then you sign.
items.description: We show you the system running before we ask you to trust us.

items.title: Few things, done with taste.
items.description: We would rather do less and do it well. Every line, word and pixel has a job.

items.title: People before code.
items.description: Software is only the form. What matters are the people who use it and the people who make it.

items.title: Born at the center of the world. Building for the rest of it.
items.description: We come from the 0° line and think about any market from day one.

items.title: Ambition without solemnity.
items.description: We want to be the software company with the most taste in the world. We mean it, without taking ourselves too seriously.
